name: L76K GPS Module - Waveshare Wiki
snippet: The first positioning of the module (cold start), under normal circumstances (outdoors, good weather, no large building block), takes 35 seconds to successfully locate, please wait patiently. If the weather conditions are bad, it may take longer to locate, or even fail to locate.

name: RTK Surveying Under Trees: How to Handle Canopy and Multipath
snippet: The fix rate—the proportion of time a Fix solution is maintained—can remain relatively high (about 93%) in comparatively favorable forest conditions, but drops significantly in more obstructed environments.

name: Tips for GNSS under trees / forested areas? : r/Surveying
snippet: The best way to get reliable results from a GPS in poor sky view conditions is taking observations at many different time intervals with satellite constellations that have changed substantially.

name: Optimize Geode for Use Under Forest Canopy | Support
snippet: Forest canopy can make it difficult for the Geode or any GNSS (GPS) receiver to locate satellites and provide precise geospatial positioning. This was demonstrated for the original Geode (aka GNS1). Beyond applying our general recommended settings for the Geode, the following suggestions may be helpful in such conditions.

name: Measuring in the Forest - RTK / PPK configuration - Emlid
snippet: In forested environments, where GNSS signal reception can be challenging due to obstructed tree canopy, the additional time spent on static observation can allow the GNSS receiver to collect and process more satellite data, which in turn improves the quality of the positioning solution.
